description: This file implements a command-line 'discover' command for a macOS application, involving network gateway discovery. It defines structures for options and output, and contains an async function to perform discovery, handle options, and output results in human-readable or JSON format.

classes.name: DiscoveryOptions
classes.description: A struct to parse and store command-line options for the discovery process.

classes.name: DiscoveryOutput
classes.description: A struct representing the JSON-serializable output of the discovery process, including nested Gateway struct for individual gateways.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses an array of command-line arguments into a DiscoveryOptions instance.

methods.name: runDiscover
methods.description: Asynchronous function that performs gateway discovery based on the specified options, handles output formatting, and displays the results.
